notes.title: Merry Christmas From Indie game studio
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas to every players and we are indie game studio and Fatal Gem is our first Match-3 VR games and hope you can enjoy it with your family during the Christmas!!!

During the game, you will be surrounded by a lot of gems and crystals, even you can touch the gems and crystals and it’s really interesting for you to make the right devision and rescued from the surrounded bombs,by eliminating the same color of gems and crystals.

Enjoy the game and enjoy your life!!!
